artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows railway tracks extending into the distance. Along the tracks are trees, structures, and a river. A small wooden structure is near the river. The photo has a monochromatic color palette and detailed elements, giving it a timeless and deep appearance.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a railway scene from a slightly above and left view. The setting includes leafless trees and buildings in the horizon, with curving tracks extending towards a vanishing point. A train is seen moving along a track to the right, emitting visible steam. Additional parallel tracks are detailed to the left, accompanied by a small station building. The color scheme is predominantly sepia, creating a vintage atmosphere. Various items such as barrels and supplies are visible on a platform, with an empty track bed nearby.

artworks.title: Cape Horn, Columbia River
artworks.creditLine: Diana and Mallory Walker Fund
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a rugged terrain. Nearby, there are tree stumps and sparse vegetation, leading to an overgrown field enclosed by a wooden fence. A small log cabin is nestled at the base of a rocky slope to the right, with a cliff face extending upwards. Coniferous trees cling to the cliff. The land descends to meet a sandy shoreline bordered by a large body of water. In the distance, the land meets a hazy horizon with hills. The color scheme consists of shades of brown, gray, and muted green, resembling early photographic techniques.

artworks.title: Oil Refinery, Erie, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial area with wooden barrels scattered around, some stacked and some upright. Wooden buildings and structures extend towards the horizon. In the background, there is a forest. The coloration is monochromatic. The image is in stereo card format.

artworks.title: Negley Run, near Tidioute (Pennsylvania Oil Regions)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial oil field or mining site in a forested landscape. Tall trees obscure the horizon, framing the scene. Wooden oil derricks are scattered throughout the site, some closer to us and others in the distance. Small wooden buildings are also present. The sepia-toned image highlights the textures of the structures and natural surroundings. Smoke rises from one of the structures.

artworks.title: Salt Lake City and Wasatch Mountains
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: The image shows a townscape with a range of snow-capped mountains in the background. In the foreground, four children are lying on the ground between two bare trees. The town with various buildings, including several church steeples, is seen further away. The mountains dominate the horizon. The image is rendered in sepia tones, with a focus on detailed natural and built elements.

artworks.title: No Cross, No Crown
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows stylized letters formed by botanical elements spelling out "No X No". The color palette features light tan or beige foliage against a deep brown background. The word "No" is split by a large "X" at the top, while the bottom section features a crown-like pattern made of fern fronds.

artworks.title: Head of a Nun
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The person is in a slightly tilted position, with their head leaning forward and slightly to the side. The facial features include closed eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The person's hair is covered, possibly by a hood or veil. The sketch does not depict detailed clothing. The background is plain with colored marks adding texture. There are markings or numbers in the bottom right corner of the paper.

artworks.title: A Kneeling Friar in Prayer
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on red prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of a person viewed from behind, shown in a kneeling position with hands openly held together in front as if in prayer. The person is depicted wearing a long robe with wide sleeves and a hood, cinched at the waist with a belt. The figure's short, neatly kept hair is visible, but facial features are not shown. The sketch is done in charcoal or pencil on brown paper, creating a textured background emphasizing the fabric folds of the robe. No additional context is provided in the plain background.

artworks.title: Ballo in Maschera (Masquerade Ball)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One person is standing on the left side of the image, wearing a dark, voluminous garment with intricate detailing, a mask, and a head covering. The other person is seated on the right side, wearing a vibrant, textured outfit, a large hat, a mask, and has styled hair. The background consists of muted gray tones with blurred floral elements and a faintly visible moon in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Elegant Woman in a Fur Coat
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting with an upright posture. They have light-colored hair peeking from under a large hat, wearing a dark garment with a light-colored scarf or fur wrapping around the neck. The person's hands are resting on a light-colored item. The background is a soft blur of dark and muted colors in shades of green and gray.

artworks.title: Workers in the Countryside
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on wove paper  [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a dirt path. A horse-drawn cart and a person are visible in the distance. The focus is on the trees, with slender branches reaching up. The brushstrokes give a sketch-like quality. The color palette is primarily gray and black. The ground texture transitions into a darker, denser wooded area in the distance.

artworks.title: Juno Surprising Jupiter and Io
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, one seated on a rock or cloud formation, another sitting on the ground and reaching up, and the third standing nearby. A peacock stands nearby with its tail feathers trailing down. The background is filled with trees, foliage, and rocky formations.

artworks.title: Mercury Killing Argus
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a detailed black and white drawing of a scene set in a rustic environment. It depicts a muscular figure on the left holding a sword above their head, standing beside a seated, heavily-built individual draped in cloth. In the background, there is an ox staring at the scene, and a dog looking up at the seated figure. The setting includes trees and a rugged landscape. The drawing features intricate cross-hatching and line work to emphasize the forms and expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Dawn, or Morning
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated vantage point over a dark landscape with trees. The horizon is obscured by the meeting of trees and the sky, mainly on the right side. The piece features intricate brushwork with fine swirling lines creating texture in the sky and land. The color palette consists of dark browns and blacks with lighter hues providing contrast and highlights. A large, gnarled tree is prominently featured on the left, with twisting branches. In the distance, faint windows of light in a cabin or building are visible among the dark woods.

artworks.title: Adéle de Saussure and Marie-Louise Ravel, the Artist's Wife, in His Studio
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper, laid down on mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin, and Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a studio setting. One woman is sitting and the other is standing. The seated woman is positioned at an angle facing the easel, leaning slightly on her left arm. The standing woman leans against a wooden table with her left hand resting on its surface. The seated woman has dark hair styled in an updo with green ribbons, and she wears a dark dress with voluminous sleeves. The standing woman has her hair in an updo and wears a light blue dress with a pink tie around the collar. The studio is richly decorated with a large canvas on an easel, leaning paintings, and various art supplies scattered around, including a rolled piece of paper on the tiled floor. The wall behind them is adorned with decorative plates and a white bust. An ornate rug is partially visible beneath the table.

artworks.title: X: Ten Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 11.9 cm (4 11/16 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18.2 cm (7 3/16 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban scene with children and a goat. The drawing shows a circular vignette enclosing three children. One child is seated on a column pedestal, another is standing beside a goat, and a third is standing holding what appears to be dolls or toys. The background features an urban setting with architectural structures like buildings and people depicted faintly in the distance, giving the scene a sense of depth. The circular frame is inscribed with text in Latin. The composition captures a moment of playful interaction among the children in a town setting.

artworks.title: XX: Twenty Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 12 cm (4 3/4 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18 cm (7 1/16 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a man and a woman, seated on a bench. The woman, on the left, is holding a plant and a small book or pamphlet. The man, on the right, has his arm around her shoulders and holds a lute on his knee. They are in a garden setting, framed by inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: XXX: Thirty Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 12 cm (4 3/4 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18 cm (7 1/16 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows three figures within a circular frame. The central standing figure appears to be holding a string connected to the seated person's hand. The standing figure has a content expression, wearing Renaissance or early Baroque attire with elaborate hair and a feathered hat, while the seated figure is a young woman with a calm expression and intricate clothing. A smaller, possibly child figure is partially visible holding onto the standing figure's clothing. The background features a castle, trees, a body of water, and a building with windows and an arched entrance. The scene is enclosed by inscribed Latin text within the frame.

artworks.title: XXXX: Forty Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 11.9 cm (4 11/16 in.) (circular, trimmed to platemark)
mount: 17.8 cm (7 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This circular print shows a scene outdoors. On the right, a man holding a tall staff and wearing a hat kneels down in front of a child. The man is wearing a collared vest over a shirt with long sleeves and knee-length breeches with tall socks. He uses a tall compass tool to draw a circle on a flat surface. The child uses a pen to write or draw something on a large pad of paper. Between the child and man is an open book. On the left, a woman sits, appearing to sew a piece of cloth on her lap. She wears a gown with large ruffles on the neck and sleeves, and her hair is put in an updo behind her head. Behind them, two other people appear to work on a building on the left. They climb up ladders to reach tall scaffolding, holding bundles on their backs. In the distance, more buildings can be seen spreading across low hills. On the right, a person herds horses up a tall peak, and below that, two people appear to fight with swords in front of another building. In the bottom right, behind the man, is the face of a lion with a long, wavy mane. Around the edge of the circular print is a border with an inscription. The print is on beige, octagonal paper.

artworks.title: L: Fifty Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 12 cm (4 3/4 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18 cm (7 1/16 in.)(octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a circular engraving capturing a dining scene with three figures and a dog. The central figure, an older man, is seated at a round table that is adorned with a tablecloth and several plates. He is depicted mid-action, raising a goblet as if making a toast. His facial hair and elaborate hat add to his distinguished appearance. To his right, another seated individual leans in with a gentle expression, peering attentively towards the man. Her hair is elaborately styled, and she is wearing an ornate outfit featuring a large ruffled collar. Standing on the right side of the table is a young boy, dressed in period-appropriate clothing with puffed sleeves and a ruffled collar, striking a casual pose with a hand on his hip, and a dog stands beside him. The background suggests an interior setting with architectural elements, such as a column and a draped curtain, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: LX: Sixty Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 11.8 cm (4 5/8 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18.1 cm (7 1/8 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a domestic setting with detailed figures engaged in an interaction. The circular image is framed within a decorative border containing text. The interior view shows two figures seated across from each other at a table. To the left, an older figure with a long beard is seated on a chair with intricate patterns. To the right, another figure, likely younger, holds an object. The scene includes wooden beams, furniture, and an animal figurine nearby. In the background, a small opening gives a glimpse into another room where a gathering appears to be taking place. The overall composition suggests a narrative or allegorical context, typical of detailed pen and ink drawings from earlier art periods.

artworks.title: LXX: Seventy Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 11.8 cm (4 5/8 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18 cm (7 1/16 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene within a circular frame. It shows a group of four people, each a full-body depiction. To the left, a man and woman are standing. The woman wears an ornate dress and a cape, while the man wears a large hat and a long coat. He has his hand around her waist and his other hand gesturing. In the center, a bearded man is seated with his legs crossed and slightly reclined, wearing a detailed buttoned robe. He holds a viewing device to his eye, and a caped attendant behind him carefully affixes a headpiece. They are in an opulent interior with decorated arches and columns in the background. To the right, a globe and stack of books rest on a table beside the seated man's chair. The background within the circular frame is richly adorned with architectural elements and drapery. Latin script surrounds the edge of the circle.

artworks.title: LXXX: Eighty Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 11.7 cm (4 5/8 in.) (circular, trimmed within platemark)
mount: 18.1 cm (7 1/8 in.) (octagonal)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an interior setting. An elderly man with a bald head and a long beard is seated in a wooden chair, leaning forward with a concentrated expression. Two young children stand in front of him. One child with curly hair reaches out towards the man, from which smoke or steam rises. The other child, seen from behind, wears a similar robe and a hat, sitting or kneeling on the floor, facing the man. The man is dressed in a long robe with a fur collar and is gesturing or reaching towards the child with both hands. To the right, a small animal is curled on the floor beside a jug near the man's chair. The room has wooden paneling, a central fireplace with an ornate arch and mantel, an open doorway, and an alcove with a decorative element. A Latin inscription encircles the scene within a circular border.
